newsitem.title: USA: Colossal starts second cobalt furnace.
newsitem.headline: Colossal starts second cobalt furnace.

text.p: Colossal Resources Corp said a second 15-tonne electric arc furnace was started up at the company's new cobalt production plant in Kabwe, Zambia on September 29.

Both of the site's 15-tonne electric furnaces are now operating to process slag containing cobalt and copper left over from copper mining. The furnaces process slag into a cobalt rich cobalt/copper/iron granulated alloy suitable for processing to higher value-added cobalt products.
Cobalt is a strategic metal used in special alloy applications such as aerospace engines.
Colossal said that in the coming weeks slag processing will be extended to two and three shift operations as more recently hired are trained.

An induction furnace for settling and granulating the cobalt rich alloy will be commissioned in November and a 10-tonne electric furnace will be installed in December when slag processing should increase to the planned first year level of about 300 tonnes per day to yield around 40 tonnes of contained cobalt per month.
Colossal said the first commercial sale of cobalt alloy was made in September.
